definition.note: Revolution of a parabola about its axis: the mirror shape that focuses a parallel beam to a point; the circular special case of the elliptic paraboloid.

provenance.definition: Classical closed form, written directly in the exact language and checked by the validator.
sources: R. Ferreol, "Paraboloid of revolution", Encyclopedie des formes mathematiques remarquables, mathcurve.com; local mirror chapter ch1314_paraboloidrevolution_2 (S:/data/math_art/references/websites/mathcurve/book/surfaces/ch1314_paraboloidrevolution_2.md).

caveats: The a = b special case of the elliptic paraboloid, which is exactly what mesh.quadric_add's ELLIPTIC_PARABOLOID builds at its defaults (both semi-axes 1): the mirror shape that focuses a parallel beam to a point.
